title: blackstonia perfoliata subsp. acuminata
intro: Blackstonia perfoliata subsp. acuminata, commonly known as "Tassel Hyacinth", is a flowering plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and relieve respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Blackstonia perfoliata subsp. acuminata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
